item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description:
What's New in Terminal Shortcuts 1.2.1

  • App Visibility Settings: New option to show app in Dock/Menu Bar or Menu Bar only.
  • Command Descriptions: Added a new description field for your commands.
  • Enhanced License Validation: Faster startup with cached verification and background checks.
  • UI Improvements: New dedicated sheets for editing Hotkeys and Schedules.
  • Better Window Management: Improved reliability when opening windows and clicking the Dock icon.
  • Contact Developer: Added contact links in Settings > About.
  • Performance: Removed verbose logging and optimized startup.
  • Bug fixes and stability improvements.

For more details, visit our GitHub releases page.
